snippet.title: Pelican Post Summer 2025 Trailer
snippet.description:
Pelican Post is a narrative game where you’ll take on the role of Pepper, who moves to a new town to take a job as a mailman. Along the way, she’ll learn that there’s more to the job than just delivering packages. By talking with and completing tasks with the colorful cast of characters who inhabit Port Pleasant, you’ll help bring people who have drifted apart over the years back together and build a stronger community. "Small acts of kindness" is pretty much in the job description.
